name: mern-setup
description: Simple MERN Stack Boilerplate Setup (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js)

scripts.install-all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: node ./node_modules/concurrently/dist/bin/concurrently.js -n SERVER,CLIENT -c cyan,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
